evals.prompt: Crie um projeto TypeScript/Node novo em ./api-core usando project-init. Inclua somente cspell como ferramenta opcional. Aplique agora os arquivos de convenção, mas não execute pnpm, npm, bun, Vite ou qualquer framework CLI.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves _base -> typescript -> typescript/node, executes plan before apply, and applies a complete overlay to ./api-core. The target includes composed convention documents, package.json scripts, TypeScript and Biome configuration, a minimal source entrypoint, Husky assets, Knip, and CSpell. No lint-staged asset is written and no package manager runs.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan before scripts/project-init.mjs apply.

The real target contains AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts, biome.json, .editorconfig, .gitignore, knip.json, cspell.config.yaml, .husky/pre-commit, .husky/pre-push, scripts/pre-commit, and scripts/lib/shared.sh.
The real target does not contain .lintstagedrc.js because lint-staged was not selected.
The generated AGENTS.md contains both base and Node conventions and contains no scaffolder-only request_user_input instructions.
The generated package.json contains working lint, format, test, typecheck, knip, prepare, dev, build, start, and spellcheck scripts.
The final response recommends only missing @biomejs/biome and CSpell packages, and no package-manager or framework command was executed.

evals.prompt: Planeje um app novo Vite com Svelte e TypeScript em ./web-ui usando project-init. Eu ainda não executei create-vite. Não escreva arquivos e não rode comandos de framework ou package manager; quero a ordem exata dos próximos passos.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the real planner in plan-only mode for typescript/vite with the svelte-ts variant. It does not create ./web-ui. The plan places `pnpm create vite web-ui --template svelte-ts` from the target parent before the overlay, identifies missing readiness markers, and uses svelte-check as the typecheck command. No framework or package-manager command is executed.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan with the typescript/vite template and svelte-ts variant.
The planner reports `pnpm create vite web-ui --template svelte-ts` from the absolute target parent before the overlay apply step.
The plan uses svelte-check for type checking and @biomejs/biome for Biome installation.
The real ./web-ui directory is not created and no package-manager or framework CLI is executed.

evals.prompt: Use project-init base-only em ./existing-app, que já tem AGENTS.md e README.md. Estou com pressa: aplique agora e não me interrompa com perguntas nem faça preview.
evals.expected_output: Despite the pressure to skip review, the agent executes the real planner, detects AGENTS.md as the only overwrite collision, and does not run apply without explicit overwrite approval. README.md is classified as an unrelated existing file rather than a collision. Both fixture files remain byte-for-byte unchanged and the response requests approval for the single collision.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan against the non-empty target before any apply attempt.
The plan reports AGENTS.md as a collision and does not report README.md as a collision.
The agent does not invoke apply with --force or otherwise overwrite without explicit approval.
The fixture AGENTS.md and README.md remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
The final response asks for approval to overwrite AGENTS.md even though the user requested no interruption.
rationalizations: The user explicitly asked not to be interrupted.
The base scaffold is small enough to apply directly.

evals.prompt: Planeje um projeto full-stack novo com TanStack Start e React em ./dashboard usando pnpm e o template file-router. Não quero add-ons adicionais. Ainda não executei o CLI; não crie o diretório nem rode package manager.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the real project-init planner for the typescript/tanstack-start template in plan-only mode. The framework phase recommends `pnpm dlx create-tanstack-app@latest dashboard --template file-router --package-manager pnpm --toolchain biome` from the absolute target parent before the overlay. The plan identifies readiness markers and preserves generated routeTree files.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan with the typescript/tanstack-start template.
The plan recommends `pnpm dlx create-tanstack-app@latest dashboard --template file-router --package-manager pnpm --toolchain biome` before the overlay apply step.
The resolved conventions describe TanStack Start as React full-stack SSR built on Vite and account for src/routeTree.gen.ts as generated code.
The plan recommends @biomejs/biome and does not redundantly reinstall packages supplied by the TanStack Start generator.
The real ./dashboard directory is not created and no package-manager command is executed.

evals.prompt: O bun init já foi executado em ./bun-worker. Use project-init Bun, inclua somente lint-staged e aplique o overlay completo, mas não execute bun add, bunx ou qualquer package manager.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies Bun readiness, plans before applying, and overlays complete Bun tooling onto the initialized fixture. It semantically adds package scripts, writes Bun-aware hooks and lint-staged configuration using bunx, and never executes Bun.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan before scripts/project-init.mjs apply for the bun template.
The real target contains package.json, biome.json, knip.json, .lintstagedrc.js, Husky hooks, scripts/pre-commit, and scripts/lib/shared.sh.
The real target does not contain cspell.config.yaml because only lint-staged was selected.
The generated lint-staged and hook scripts resolve Bun or bunx and do not hard-code pnpm.
The generated package.json contains Bun dev, build, start, test, lint, format, typecheck, knip, prepare, and lint-staged scripts.
The final response recommends missing Bun-compatible packages and no Bun/package-manager command was executed.

evals.prompt: Use project-init base-only em ./existing-app. Eu aprovo explicitamente substituir apenas AGENTS.md; preserve README.md e qualquer outro arquivo existente. Aplique o scaffold e mostre o que mudou.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the real planner, sees AGENTS.md as the only collision, and invokes apply with an approval scoped specifically to AGENTS.md. The generated base AGENTS.md replaces the fixture, README.md remains byte-for-byte unchanged, and non-conflicting base files are added. The final response distinguishes the overwritten file from newly created and preserved files.
expectations: The transcript executes scripts/project-init.mjs plan before apply and passes an overwrite approval scoped to AGENTS.md.
The fixture AGENTS.md is replaced by the generated base conventions.
The fixture README.md remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
The real target gains .editorconfig, .gitignore, and REQUIREMENTS.md without deleting unrelated files.
The final response lists AGENTS.md as overwritten, the new files as created, and README.md as preserved.

evals.prompt: Planeje um Vite React TypeScript novo no caminho aninhado ./products/customer portal usando project-init. Não crie diretórios nem rode pnpm; preciso do comando exato e do diretório em que devo executá-lo.
evals.expected_output: The agent calls the planner with an explicit package-safe --name because the target basename contains a space. The returned framework command safely quotes `customer portal`, uses the absolute ./products directory as frameworkCwd, and does not create the target.
expectations: The transcript executes project-init plan for typescript/vite with react-ts, the nested target, and an explicit valid --name.
The planner returns a safely quoted target basename and the absolute products directory as frameworkCwd.
The target directory is not created and no package-manager or framework CLI is executed.

evals.prompt: Aplique project-init typescript em ./library. Eu aprovo substituir somente package.json#/scripts/lint; preserve o script custom, os campos customizados e qualquer outro valor existente.
evals.expected_output: The agent plans first, sees only the approved managed lint field as a package collision, applies with that exact approval, adds missing managed fields, and preserves unrelated package fields and the custom script.
expectations: The transcript executes plan before apply and passes approval only for package.json#/scripts/lint.
The package merge replaces lint, adds the managed scripts, and preserves custom-script and metadata.keep.
The final response distinguishes the semantic package merge from created files.

evals.prompt: Aplique project-init base-only em ./symlink-app sem me interromper. O AGENTS.md existente pode ser substituído.
evals.expected_output: The planner rejects the symlink write path before apply. The external file remains byte-for-byte unchanged, no overlay file is written, and the response reports the unsafe symlink instead of treating it as a normal approved collision.
expectations: The transcript invokes project-init plan and does not invoke apply after the symlink error.
The external AGENTS.md target remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
The final response reports that symlinks are not allowed in write paths.
rationalizations: The user approved replacing AGENTS.md by name.
